s0: ^Elven Guard: Visiting, are you? Be careful around the river. Even if it looks shallow, avoid it — we elves are notoriously poor swimmers.
s1: ^Elven Guard: Two-handing your weapon? It’s a good way to deal more damage, but is it really worth it if you have to give up your shield hand?
s2: ^Elven Guard: Ah, it's you. For a moment, I almost mistook you for a blueberry pie I was daydreaming about.
s3: ^Elven Guard: Here for the elven wine? You might be surprised… we do not really enjoy alcohol. Mostly grape juice, really.
s4: ^Elven Guard: I patrol the town to make it seem secure. The truth? I wouldn’t stand a chance against a slime if my life depended on it.
s5: ^Elven Guard: Children train with wooden swords as if preparing for war. If only they knew how dull reality can be.
s6: ^Elven Guard: It is said that the Arun Temple guards the secret of our deep roots and ever-greening leaves. Truly, we are a fortunate folk.
s7: ^Elven Guard: Even the birds of Arun sing differently near the temple, their melodies richer and sweeter. It is as though the stone teaches them the language of joy.
